item.title: San Diegans brave cold for snow on Mount Laguna
item.description: San Diegans enjoyed the snow at the top of Mount Laguna, making snowmen, sledding and taking pictures after a recent storm.

item.title: Man dies in San Diego Sheriff's custody; investigation underway
item.description: Authorities are investigating after a 35-year-old man who was in custody of the San Diego County Sheriff's Office (SDSO) died at a local hospital early Wednesday morning.

item.title: MTS ramps up trolley service for San Diego FC home opener on Saturday
item.description: San Diego MTS is offering a discounted all-season transit pass and increased trolley service for San Diego FC fans attending home games at Snapdragon Stadium.

item.title: More rainfall in store for San Diego County: When will the second storm hit?
item.description: Heavy rainfall, wind, and high-surf advisories are in effect for San Diego County, with a winter storm warning in place until Thursday, and city crews monitoring river levels and providing sandbags to prevent flooding.

item.title: Petition and rally Wednesday calls on Escondido to cancel its contract with ICE
item.description: Escondido City leaders are being urged to cancel its contract with ICE to use its city-owned shooting range, with a petition of over 3,000 signatures delivered to city leaders ahead of the city council meeting on February 25th.

item.title: Slighty Stoopid to host Field of Dreamz Festival at Petco Park with special guests
item.description: Slightly Stoopid is hosting its inaugural Field of Dreamz Festival at Petco Park on June 13, featuring a lineup of San Diego-based rock and reggae bands, including Sublime, Stephen Marley, The Elovaters, Pepper, DENM, Z-Trip, Band of Gringos and Boostive.

item.title: Santana and Doobie Brothers to perform in San Diego as part of joint summer tour
item.description: Carlos Santana and The Doobie Brothers are embarking on the Oneness Tour 2026, which will make a stop in San Diego on August 11th at the North Island Credit Amphitheatre.

item.title: Deputy-involved shooting in San Marcos leaves one person dead
item.description: SAN MARCOS, Calif. (FOX 5/KUSI) -- The San Diego County Sheriff's Office confirmed an officer-involved shooting occurred in San Marcos on Wednesday night, leaving one person dead. item.title: La Jolla's iconic 'Mushroom House' undergoing renovations
item.description: A La Jolla-based contractor has begun renovations on the "Mushroom House," a 58-year-old architectural landmark buried into the cliffs above San Diego's Blacks Beach.

item.title: Former nonprofit COO accused of using grant money for cosmetic surgery
item.description: Prosecutors have charged the former chief operating officer of a San Diego nonprofit with embezzling public grant money intended to prevent fentanyl overdoses.
